Each orbit is independently configurable with custom speed, direction (CW/CCW), color, glow, and traveler box size. Built with pure SVG + rAF — no external 3D library required. Perfect for loaders, hero sections, tech dashboards, or orbit/network visualizations.

name: Chain Carousel
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A horizontally scrolling carousel component for displaying blockchain chains, tokens, or custom items. It features auto-scroll with smooth Framer Motion animations, center highlighting, left/right mirrored displays, and an interactive search dropdown for selecting and focusing on specific items. Perfect for dashboards, explorers, and interactive listings.

name: Interactive Grid Background
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A fully interactive grid background component with glowing trails and idle animations. The grid reacts to mouse movement, creating a smooth trail effect, and automatically animates random cells when idle. Supports light/dark mode, glow effects, and optional fade overlays for visual depth.

name: Beam Grid Background
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A visually dynamic grid background with animated beam effects and interactive highlights. Beams move across the grid in both X and Y directions, with optional glow effects and multi-level highlights around the mouse pointer. Supports light/dark mode, idle animations, and optional fade overlays. Ideal for hero sections, dashboards, or any immersive UI background.

name: Electro Border
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A dynamic animated border with an electric, distortion-based effect. Supports optional glow and aura layers for an energized or minimal look.

name: Rays Background
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A vibrant, conic and radial-based animated background effect inspired by cosmic light rays. Perfect for hero sections, modals, or theme transitions with full Tailwind and dark/light mode support.

name: Fall Beam Background
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A lightweight, animated background effect featuring vertical, glowing 'beams' or lines that continuously fall. Ideal for subtle data-stream, matrix, or sci-fi themes. It supports custom colors and line density.

name: 3d Image Carousel
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A responsive, 3D-styled image slider with a cascade effect that smoothly transitions between slides. Supports drag, touch, and autoplay interactions, while remaining fully Tailwind-compatible for design customization. Only minimal embedded CSS is used to maintain the 3D stacking and positioning logic.

name: 3d Slider
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A responsive, 3D image/content slider with a smooth, cascaded stacking effect. It uses Framer Motion for the complex 3D transforms (translateX, translateY, rotate) and handles interactivity via global document event listeners for mouse wheel, drag, and touch gestures. The component is styled using Tailwind CSS and is fully self-contained.

name: Dot Grid Background
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An interactive hexagonal dot-grid background. Drag in any direction â€” dots scale by proximity to center with smooth inertia physics. Fully configurable: dot size, color, spacing, scale falloff, and momentum. Built on Canvas API for 60 FPS with zero layout cost.

name: Looping Words
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An animated, professional looping words effect inspired by Osmo. It displays a list of words vertically and animates them upwards sequentially while highlighting the currently active word with an animated corner-bracket selector. Built with Framer Motion for smooth, seamless infinite scrolling.

name: Infinite Drift
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A high-performance Three.js based image marquee with independent horizontal bands, custom vertex shaders for curvature effects, and smooth inertial scrolling. Ideal for hero sections or premium galleries.

name: Infinite Drift 2
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An advanced WebGL-powered 3D inverted dome lens gallery featuring procedural infinite tiled image grids, real-time radial curvature distortion, multi-touch inertial drag physics, automatic smooth drift panning, and customizable tile rotation, zoom, vignette, and grayscale filters.

name: Cinematic Scroll
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A premium scrollable container that features layered, progressive blur masking at the top and bottom edges. It creates a cinematic 'fade-out' effect for content as it enters or leaves the scrollable area, paired with a high-performance custom scrollbar built with Framer Motion. This component is designed to elevate long-form content, sidebars, or complex layouts with a professional editorial aesthetic.

name: Spectrum Loader
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A professional SVG-based loading indicator that features a vibrant, animated rainbow spectrum. By leveraging layered radial gradients and cinematic glow filters, it creates a premium visual experience. The component uses Framer Motion for high-performance spinning and stroke-draw animations, making it both smooth and highly customizable through props.

name: Hanging Id Card
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A physics-based ID card component that hangs from a rope at the top. Features realistic pendulum physics with spring return, drag interaction, and gravity simulation. Click or drag the card left/right and watch it swing with authentic momentum before settling back to center.

name: Sparkle Cursor
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A high-performance WebGL GSAP animated cursor effect. As the user moves the mouse, an array of rotating, falling sparkles and cinematic glowing orbs trail behind. Built entirely on an overlay canvas using hardware-accelerated GSAP tweens, ensuring a silky smooth 60fps experience without causing React re-renders or layout thrashing.

name: Grain Cursor
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A retro-dithered WebGL cursor shader component. Utilizes a Three.js ping-pong simulation buffer and an 8x8 Bayer ordered dithering matrix to render an authentic, high-speed particle grain cursor trail. Highly configurable with brush radius, decay, intensity, grain size, falloff exponent, color, and container-binding modes.

name: Vector Flow
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A premium interactive background component featuring a high-density, multi-layered particle flow field simulation driven by domain-warped classic 2D Perlin noise. Includes dynamic speed-based color interpolation, physical velocity cursor drag, and transparent double-pass neon volumetric glow trails that fit perfectly on any page theme.

name: Neural Link
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An advanced interactive background component simulating a neural net connection grid. Floating node connections dynamically route glowing data packets along paths to cursor coordinates.

name: Magnetic Field
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An advanced interactive background component simulating a physical magnetic vector field. Needle lines representing compass vectors rotate dynamically to align with magnetic flux, and glowing tracer particles travel along the lines of force.

name: Ether Waves
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An interactive WebGL background rendering a 3D cybernetic constellation wave field. It projects a flowing net of glowing star nodes and micro-thin lines that warp, tilt, and glow white-hot near the cursor coordinates.

name: Fluid Chrome
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An advanced, interactive WebGL-based background component simulating a highly reflective liquid metallic chrome surface. Time-based fractional Brownian motion (FBM) noise drives organic waves, while mouse movements create expanding dynamic ripple deformations. Illumination is computed via Blinn-Phong specular reflections and iridescent normal mapping.

name: Cyber Hive
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An advanced interactive WebGL hexagonal grid background. The tiles pulse with customized breathing speeds and warp in scale, bevel specular reflection, and glow intensity when hovered by the cursor.

name: Cosmic Singularity
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An advanced interactive WebGL particle accretion disk background. Features a split particle population where background stars drift in full view and get dynamically pulled by gravity to circulate around the cursor's gravity well.

name: Fluid Action Panel
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A professional, highly interactive floating utility widget that morphs between a collapsed progress trigger and an expanded glassmorphic settings dashboard. Features page scroll progress tracking, custom theme togglers, and clean copy-link and social sharing shortcuts with responsive touch controls.

name: Knowledge Convergence
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An animated AI knowledge convergence hub component connecting multi-source data feeds (YouTube, Medium, GitHub, LeetCode, PDF/Word documents) into a central target title with glowing bezier beams, energy flow particles, and full light/dark theme support.

name: Wavy Ripple Background
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An interactive WebGL shader background featuring concentric waving ripple rings that expand and fade. Responds smoothly to mouse movements and supports full theme customizability.

name: 3d Glass Coin Carousel
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: Procedural WebGL 2 raymarching of glass-morphic coins rotating in a tilted 3D orbit with fresnel edge highlights, refraction, and specular lighting around center text.

name: Cool Slide Gallery
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A premium 3D coverflow-style image gallery built with Framer Motion. Cards fan out in a smooth perspective layout with configurable tilt, depth, scale, and rotation. Supports drag/swipe, keyboard navigation, autoplay, dot indicators, navigation arrows, title overlays with gradient veils, badge labels, slide counter, and extensive customisation. Fully transparent background with seamless light and dark mode support.

name: Scroll Cards
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A high-performance scroll-driven stacked cards component powered by GSAP and ScrollTrigger. As the user scrolls, current cards scale down and rotate elegantly while subsequent cards slide in from any direction (bottom, top, left, or right). Ideal for showcase galleries, portfolio highlights, and interactive storyboards.

name: Celestial Rays
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A high-performance WebGL volumetric light beam background shader component built with Three.js. Features OkLab perceptual color interpolation, perspective tilt projection, volumetric ray casting, natural turbulence drift, and interactive cursor flaring.

name: Animated Glassy
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A high-performance WebGL refractive floating glass membrane and liquid silk background. Features realistic lens refraction, 3D specular rim glints, dual chained warp fluid dynamics, tritone color mapping, and seamless dark and light mode adaptation.

name: Animated Prism
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A high-performance WebGL chromatic dispersion optical prism background component. Features realistic light refraction, spectral caustic caustics, multi-variant color presets, interactive cursor beam tracking, film grain anti-banding, and seamless dark and light mode adaptation.

name: Animated Flow
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A high-performance WebGL domain-warping fluid gradient background component. Features multi-variant color presets, customizable noise scale, film grain, domain warping, rotation angle, and seamless light and dark mode theme switching.

name: Animated Grain
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A high-performance WebGL procedural Bayer dither wave background component. Features pixel quantization, multi-harmonic domain warping, dynamic cursor interaction, analog film grain, and light and dark mode theme switching.

name: Animated Particles
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A high-performance WebGL particle vector field component with custom shapes (circle, star, square, diamond, ring, cross, random), diverse spatial distributions (random, spiral, orbital, wave, grid, image), curl noise flow physics, and interactive cursor velocity dynamics.

name: World Map
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: A high-performance interactive SVG dotted world map featuring accurate lat/long coordinates, live multi-timezone beacon pings, curved connection arcs with animated particles, and rich dark & light mode styling.

name: Grain Carousel
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An interactive 3D lenticular dual-image carousel with animated holographic gradient foil, micro film grain, and elevation tilt effects.

name: 3d Image Pageflip
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An interactive 3D book and magazine page flip component featuring dynamic spine shifting, realistic lighting crease shadows, hover peeking, and leaf stacking.

name: Shader Card
author: Muhilan / Lightswind
description: An interactive WebGL fluid plasma shader card with cursor turbulence displacement, dynamic lighting glow, and 3D perspective tilt.

description: 3D hyperspace warp starfield canvas with customizable wave frequency, star count, and speed by @designali-in.
